# Tstack attribution

Adapted from [Theo Browne's tstack](https://github.com/t3dotgg/tstack). Keep the [MIT license](LICENSE) with redistributed copies.

`sources.json` records the upstream baseline and selected skills. Git records maintained content. The included `pr-wait` helper retains its imported bytes and executable mode. Local integration text, reference documents, checker, and tests include maintained changes. The upstream license does not assign a new license to original additions.
